items.title: FBI Arrests Another ShinyHunters Suspect Reportedly Involved in Its Jobs Portal Hack
items.one_liner: A third arrest in the ShinyHunters FBI breach highlights a critical supply-chain failure involving unpatched contractor-managed software.
items.summary: The FBI has arrested a Canadian suspect in Pennsylvania believed to be involved in the ShinyHunters breach of the FBI's jobs portal. This marks the third arrest related to the incident, which exposed sensitive medical, psychiatric, and personal data of FBI agents and applicants. The breach was traced to a contractor's failure to apply a security patch on a platform reportedly identified as Oracle PeopleSoft managed by Accenture. FBI Director Kash Patel stated the agency is continuing to work with international partners to dismantle the remaining elements of the ShinyHunters group.
items.bottom_line: The FBI jobs portal breach, which leaked sensitive agent data, was caused by a contractor's failure to patch a known vulnerability on an Oracle PeopleSoft platform.
